skill.name: react-email
skill.description: Build production-ready React Email templates for transactional messages, newsletters, localized content, and provider sending workflows.
skill.summary: Guides React Email template creation, preview, styling, i18n, static assets, and sending provider setup.
skill.author: resend

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are false positives from Markdown fences, JSX template literals, placeholder URLs, and test anti-patterns. I confirmed the setup commands, dynamic i18n imports, and email-sending examples as legitimate but security-sensitive capabilities. No prompt injection or hidden exfiltration instructions were found.

remediation.issue: Package-manager commands run during setup and preview.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for explicit user approval before running npx, npm, yarn, pnpm, or bun commands, and prefer pinned package versions where possible.

remediation.issue: Locale and namespace values are interpolated into dynamic import paths.
remediation.suggestion: Validate locale, language, and namespace values against fixed allowlists before dynamic imports, and document safe fallback behavior.

remediation.issue: Email sending examples can transmit content to external recipients.
remediation.suggestion: Require verified sender domains, explicit user approval, and test recipients before any real email delivery.

remediation.issue: Provider credentials are needed for sending workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Keep API keys in environment variables, avoid logging them, and recommend least-privilege provider credentials.

content.value_statement: React Email projects need templates that render reliably across clients. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structure, styling, i18n, tests, and sending.
actual_capabilities: Scaffolds React Email projects and starts the local preview workflow.
Creates templates with React Email components, preview text, and Tailwind styling.
Handles static images, production asset URLs, and email-safe image formats.
Adds localization patterns with next-intl, react-i18next, and react-intl.
Explains rendering and sending through Resend, Nodemailer, or SendGrid.
Applies test guidance for Gmail clipping, Outlook layout, and unsupported CSS.
limitations: It does not replace real inbox and client rendering tests.
It requires Node tooling and React Email dependencies in the project.
Sending examples require verified domains and provider credentials.
Compliance, unsubscribe rules, and consent still need business review.

use_cases.title: Transactional Onboarding
use_cases.description: Create welcome, verification, and password reset emails with safe props and preview text.

use_cases.title: Newsletter Production
use_cases.description: Turn brand assets and article content into email-safe newsletter layouts.

use_cases.title: Provider Delivery Setup
use_cases.description: Render React Email templates and connect them to Resend, SMTP, or SendGrid workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Welcome Email
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a React Email welcome email for a new user. Ask for brand color, logo, tone, and verification URL before writing it.

prompt_templates.title: Add Brand Assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Update my React Email template with a hosted logo, production asset URL, preview text, and email-safe Tailwind styling.

prompt_templates.title: Localize a Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Add English, Spanish, and French localization to this React Email template. Include fallback behavior and locale-specific formatting.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Sending Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Render this React Email template for sending with Resend. Include plain text output, verified sender guidance, and a safe test-send plan.

output_examples.input: Build a password reset email for Acme with a blue brand color.
output_examples.output: A React Email password reset template plan with preview text, secure reset link prop, branded CTA, and client testing notes.

output_examples.input: Create a localized order confirmation email for English and French users.
output_examples.output: A multi-locale template structure with translated subjects, currency formatting, fallback guidance, and safe order link handling.

output_examples.input: Show me how to send this template through Resend.
output_examples.output: A sending workflow that renders HTML and plain text, uses environment-based credentials, and requires a verified sender domain.

best_practices: Ask for brand color, logo, tone, and production asset URL before coding.
Use pixel-based Tailwind settings and email-safe layouts for broad client support.
Verify sender domains and test previews before any real delivery.
anti_patterns: Hardcoding localhost or placeholder URLs in production email templates.
Using relative image paths, SVG, WebP, flexbox, or grid for critical email layout.
Sending real emails before recipient consent, domain verification, and content review.

faq.question: Can this skill create complete React Email templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides component structure, preview text, Tailwind styling, props, and email-safe layout choices.

faq.question: Does it send emails automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides sending guidance, but real sends require provider credentials, verified domains, and user approval.

faq.question: Which providers does it cover?
faq.answer: It includes guidance for Resend, Nodemailer, SMTP, and SendGrid workflows.

faq.question: Can it handle localized emails?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers next-intl, react-i18next, react-intl, fallback translations, and locale formatting.

faq.question: Does it support images in email?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains static folders, hosted asset URLs, alt text, and formats that work better in email clients.

faq.question: Do generated emails still need testing?
faq.answer: Yes. Email clients differ, so test in Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, and other target clients.
